headline: Sugarfish
title: Sugarfish | Sweet Blob Ice Support | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sugarfish is a stage one Ice Aniimo with high energy regen. Sugary Gravity makes a slowing zone, blocks jumping for two seconds, then pulls targets to the center. Sugar-Rush Tackle tosses Sweet Blobs that restore energy when picked up. Homeland work is Ice, Leisure and Hauling at level one. At level sixty two a Freeze Stone evolves it. Will you pick Sugarslime or Sugartini? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Pick them up to restore energy

description: Aniimo Sugarfish guide: a stage 1 Ice support with Sugary Gravity and energy-restoring Sweet Blobs. Evolves at level 62 with a Freeze Stone into Sugarslime or Sugartini. Checked on aniimo.gg and GameWith in November 2026.
joke: Sugarfish hides in the shade, because melting is not a battle strategy.
